news.title: GPT-6.1 Terra: measured tool-workflow value
news.summary: AA Medium: index 41, AutomationBench 58%, $0.10/task; Sol Medium48/63%/$0.21. OpenAI reports stronger computer use and Max coding; those vendor claims are separate. Work/Codex/API, not ChatGPT Chat; higher independent effort metrics remain pending.

news.title: Recurring API credits for eligible Max/Team plans
news.summary: Max5x $100/month; Max20x $200; Team $20/Standard or $100/Premium seat, pooled up to$500. Seven-day eligibility and one linked Console organization required. Credits expire each billing cycle, with no rollover. API billing benefit, not a token-price or subscription-limit change.

news.title: Argon introductory API pricing
news.summary: $2 input / $10 output per million tokens through November 30, then $4 / $20. API offer only; subscription allowances are separate.

review.note: Moved 43 AA points to Intelligence Index v5.0 in one pass (index, cost per task, AutomationBench, Terminal-Bench, AA-Omniscience v1.1). Four points without a complete v5.0 row keep v4.3.2 values off current charts. GDPval-AA, SciCode and no-tools HLE are retired by AA and frozen at v4.3.2 with v4.3.2 costs. Frozen local scores/dates unchanged.

overall_value_leader.basis: For ordinary branching tool workflows: AutomationBench 58% at $0.17 per task (AA v5.0 costs). Sol medium scores 63% at 2.1 times the cost, below the upgrade rule. Work/Codex/API only, not ChatGPT Chat. Use Sol low for consequential facts and Sol xhigh for coding. API costs do not measure subscription savings.

rule: An upgrade pays when it adds at least 5 points (or 75 Elo on GDPval) for each doubling of cost per task. Below that, the cheaper setting is the sweet spot.
